name: singlet_spatial_domains_multi_slice_domains
title: Multi-slice joint spatial domains
description: Assigns one domain label per spot or cell in a label space shared by several spatial slices (serial sections, replicates or donors), after batch correction. The default method bass fits a joint Bayesian model with a Potts-type spatial prior; cellcharter, banksy_concat and banksy_harmony are faster comparators. Requires layers/counts, obsm/spatial and obs/sample_id, and n_domains must be given. Writes obs/domain_joint and, for probabilistic methods, obsm/domain_joint_prob. Do NOT use for one section (use the single-slice task), to choose the number of domains (use the domain-number task) or to align slices into one coordinate frame (use the registration tasks).

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle holding all slices.

method.description: bass: joint Bayesian model (default). cellcharter: pooled Gaussian mixture. banksy_concat: neighbourhood features computed per section, then concatenated. banksy_harmony: Harmony over slices.

n_domains.description: Shared number of domains K across all slices. Required. Choose it with the domain-number task, not from annotation.

batch_key.description: obs column identifying the slice; set the donor column as well when donors differ.

n_pcs.description: Principal components used by all methods; capped by the components available in obsm/X_pca.

n_cell_types.description: Number of jointly clustered cell-type groups C. Required when method is bass.

burnin.description: MCMC burn-in iterations discarded before summarising.

n_layers.description: Number of neighbourhood layers aggregated. Required when method is cellcharter.

aggregations.description: Aggregation applied to each neighbourhood layer.

banksy.description: Options for methods banksy_concat and banksy_harmony.

lambda_spatial.description: Weight of the spatial neighbour average against own expression.

k_geom.description: Spatial neighbours per unit, within its slice. The reference Harmony script uses 18 and the reference concatenation script uses 6.

harmony_theta.description: Diversity penalty for slice mixing in Harmony; used by banksy_harmony only.

harmony_sigma.description: Cluster width in Harmony; used by banksy_harmony only.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when the method has a CUDA path and enough memory is free.

seed.description: Seed for initialisation, MCMC, mixture fitting and Harmony clustering. Record it.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without computing labels.

overwrite.description: Replace existing domain_joint members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, for example obs/domain_joint. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Summary for completed runs. Keys: method, n_domains, n_sections, section_mixing, and mean_max_probability for probabilistic methods. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device, and MCMC iterations for bass.
